mapper.sql: select id, title, image_url, document_id, sort_order, status, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wl_banner

select b.id, b.title, b.image_url, b.document_id, b.sort_order, b.status, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, d.title as document_title, c.name as document_category_name, d.file_format as document_file_format, case when d.del_flag = '0' and d.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end as document_selectable from wl_banner b left join wl_document d on d.id = b.document_id left join wl_category c on c.id = d.category_id
mapper.select: select b.id, b.title, b.image_url, b.document_id from wl_banner b inner join wl_document d on d.id = b.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' inner join wl_category c on c.id = d.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '0' and (b.start_time is null or b.start_time <= #{currentTime}) and (b.end_time is null or b.end_time > #{currentTime}) order by b.sort_order asc, b.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into wl_banner(title, image_url, document_id, sort_order, status, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) select #{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{documentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0' from wl_document d where d.id = #{documentId} and d.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update wl_banner set title = #{title}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, document_id = #{documentId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and exists (select 1 from wl_document d where d.id = #{documentId} and d.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and d.del_flag = '0')
